Subject: Intro + demo — VP/CIO availability

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier this week. We ran a short internal kickoff and the execs (CIO Ravi Patel and VP Product Priya Menon) are keen to see a focused demo of Redwood centered on latency/cost tradeoffs and the Dedicated offering.

We have a tight window next week where both Ravi and Priya are available together: Tue 11/24 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 11/25 13:00–13:45 PT. If those don't work we'd prefer Tue afternoon 3:00–3:45 PT but that may mean Ravi joins remotely for the last 20.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can (a) bring a short 25–30 minute exec-friendly demo, (b) have an SE available for a 10–15 minute deep-dive, and (c) outline backup coverage plan if one of the execs has to drop?

Also attaching a 1‑pager on HelioHealth's priorities for context.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this.

Simon
Director, Platform Architecture
HelioHealth

Ben / Marcus —

Looping you in to confirm coverage. Simon has narrowed the windows down; priority is a 25–30 minute high-level demo followed by a 10–15 minute SE deep-dive. Two things we need to lock: an exec-facing narrative (latency, predictable throughput, Dedicated isolation) and a coverage / fallback plan if Ravi needs to drop early.

Marcus: are you available Tue 11/24 10:00 PT or Wed 11/25 13:00 PT to lead the SE portion? If both are tight, can you do the Tue afternoon 3:00 PT option with Ben on standby for last‑mile?

Ben: happy to own the exec intro. If Marcus is on the Tue late option and Ravi drops, we should have a pre-agreed summary slide and a backup 10‑minute Q&A flow. I attached a draft agenda — feel free to edit.

Proposed agenda (draft):
- 00:00–02:30: Intro + value props (Ben)
- 02:30–12:30: Live demo + perf snapshots (Marcus)
- 12:30–22:30: SE deep dive / architecture Q&A (Marcus)
- 22:30–25:00: Next steps / mutual action items (All)

For external: Simon/Priya — can you confirm which window you prefer and whether Ravi will definitely be on-camera for the full slot? If there's a risk he drops, who is the delegated attendee from their side?

Thanks — Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Grace / Ben —

I can do Tue 11/24 10:00 PT for the main slot and Wed 11/25 13:00 PT as an alternate. Prefer Tue morning. If we lock Tue and Ravi needs to drop at ~10:30, I can pivot to the technical snapshot and have Ben close with outcomes. Ben — if you can hold the 3:00 PT slot as a fallback that'd be perfect; I'll leave the deep config notes in the doc for you.

Also: for execs, let's keep the demo to slides + two short recorded perf runs rather than a long live run to avoid any runtime instability. I'll bring a one-slide appendix with 'if-you-want-more' links.
